description: Make a statement with your morning cup of joe. The Vandor Disney Mickey Mouse Ugly Sweater 20 Ounce Ceramic Mug is made from high quality stoneware and features a bold and bright character design. Both microwave and dishwasher safe, it ships in a full color gift box and makes the ideal gift for any occasion. Making retro cool since 1957, legends live on at Vandor - suppliers of hip and functional products for fans of all ages.
